title: Throckmorton ciphertexts in BL Add MS 4136

steps.what: Web tool could not fetch DECODE records.
Read local Tomokiyo unsolved list: three reconstructed ciphers; two named unresolved cases outside this target; superscript description belongs to another target.
Authenticated DECODE download succeeded with existing cookie after sandbox network escalation. Retrieved R9220 and eleven R9262 key images; remaining target records downloading.
Viewed alphabet, nulls, place codes and word codes in third cipher; testing against f.110.

Existing dossier maps all twenty target records to CSP Foreign II, V and VI, with Forbes counterparts for many. Most matches are date/addressee matches, not full cipher alignments. Tomokiyo already cites Forbes and the archived keys.
Rechecked downloaded image inventory: 54 target references, 39 unique JPEGs; four key records add 17 JPEGs. R9220 and R9221 are byte-identical copies of f.110. SHA-256 inventory preserved.

Visually rechecked 27-token R9220 extract (6) against R9262 P1, P3, P4 and P9: all be it i be revoked or the warr breake. Forbes I p.355 agrees. This is a known-plaintext verification, not a blind break.
Transcribed and replayed 15 alphabet tokens at R9230 extract (1): orleans or burges. R9262 P1 agrees; Forbes II p.12 and CSP V no.425 paragraph 11 identify the passage.
Identified R9257 as a mixed Percy ciphertext/key leaf and R9261 as Smith cipher, so proximity alone does not establish key applicability. R9255 combines multiple writers.

Downloaded and viewed Forbes facsimiles: I p.355 confirms the complete R9220 sample. II p.12 confirms Orleans or Burges; corrected inherited erroneous p.31 citation and pp.28–35 range. Pages 31, 32 and 34 were inspected while locating the correct page; they are later August material.

Full texts listed in outcome.texts (George Lasry's request of 22 Oct 2026): copied the CSP Foreign abstracts per record to texts/; linked the R9220 and R9230 control extracts; full decipherments and ciphertexts not transcribed

outcome.method_basis: The twenty records were matched to printed decipherments in Forbes (1740-41) and CSP Foreign; Tomokiyo's archived key R9262 in the same volume was checked on only two samples (42 tokens) that agree with Forbes.
outcome.notes: Prior published plaintext and archived keys identified; two short samples (42 tokens total) verified. Twenty-record source concordance is not an end-to-end decipherment. Composite-record non-Throckmorton material and complete transcription remain unverified.

credits.note: Full View I (1740), II (1741): printed decipherments matched to the records
archived key DECODE R9262 (Add MS 4136), checked on two samples
had identified the keys and editions (elizabeth.htm)
